subject: Re: Terrain Labs — multi-app expansion & staged onboarding agenda
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@terrainlabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@terrainlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-app expansion planning

Thanks Jasmine — we reviewed the initial proposal and are excited to move forward. A couple of asks from our side before the kickoff:

- We have three additional internal apps that want access over the next two quarters (SearchAssist, ComposeAI, and FraudGuard).
- Each app needs an isolated API key and per-app usage limits for governance (we prefer keys scoped to project).
- Expected peak concurrent QPS across all apps: ~1,200 requests/minute; peak token throughput modeled in the attached Terrain_QoS_requirements.pdf.
- For procurement we need an updated term sheet showing the incremental committed capacity and how that affects committed spend / discounts.
Can you confirm whether you can (1) provision scoped keys with per-key quotas, (2) suggest a staged rollout cadence to keep latency within SLOs, and (3) provide an updated term sheet we can present to finance next week?

Thanks — Emily
Emily Park
Head of Platform Integrations, Terrain Labs
emily.park@terrainlabs.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@terrainlabs.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@terrainlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-app expansion planning

Appreciate the detail, Emily — this is a great outline. Short answers up front:

1) Yes — we can create per-project API keys with quota and RBAC controls. Keys can be scoped and rotated independently.
2) Staged rollout: recommended 3-phase plan (pilot -> ramp -> full). I sketched a sprint-by-sprint cadence below.
3) Term sheet: attaching a MAP (minimum annual purchase) variant with the incremental commit and proposed stepped discounts. See Terrain-MAP-v2-term-sheet.xlsx attached.
Proposed staged rollout (high level):
- Week 0-2 (Pilot): Provision one key for SearchAssist (low QPS synthetic traffic). Validate latency, KV cache behavior, and prefix caching.
- Week 3-6 (Ramp): Add ComposeAI under second key, enable auto-batching rules tuned to short-text prompts, increase burst quota to handle spike windows.
- Week 7-12 (Full rollout): Add FraudGuard, enable cross-key caching policies where allowed, and move keys into production quotas.
I'll loop in Ben to confirm the capacity pack and pricing for the stepped commit. Would you prefer we sync tomorrow for 30 min to walk the term sheet and the Pilot acceptance criteria?
Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
*jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com*

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Terrain multi-app expansion — capacity & pricing check

Forwarding Terrain ask and Jasmine's plan. Quick notes:

- Peak ~1,200 req/min translates to roughly 20k tokens/min at expected prompt sizes — need to map to committed throughput (tokens/sec) and burst buffers.
- Suggested committed profile: 250M tokens/month MAP with a 20% burst pool on top for peak windows. That maps to our mid-tier Dedicated uplift discount.
- Pricing: If they move to a stepped MAP over 6 months (25%/50%/100% ramp), we can offer a 12% volume discount on incremental capacity and an onboarding credit of $6k for pilot engineering support.
Lauren — can you confirm whether scoped API key provisioning + per-key quotas will require any manual ops or is it self-serve via Console? Also, we should flag the need for a SOC2 evidence package if their security team asks.
Ben
Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Terrain multi-app expansion — capacity & pricing check

Ben — scoped keys are supported via Console and API. Admins can create keys scoped to project and set per-key quotas and soft/hard limits. A couple of operational notes to include for the customer:

- Governance: Each key will appear under their org account; we recommend creating a separate Service Account per app (SearchAssist, ComposeAI, FraudGuard).
- Quota enforcement: soft alerts at 85% usage; hard block at 100% unless they have burst buffer allowances. We can wire alerts into their Slack/PagerDuty during the Pilot.
I can draft a short Operations Checklist to include in the kickoff pack (key creation, rotation cadence, alert thresholds, testing scripts). Jasmine — send me the target emails and I’ll prepare the checklist before the call.
-Lauren
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@terrainlabs.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@terrainlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:56:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-app expansion planning — proposed time for sync
Emily / Tom — thanks again. Can we do 30 minutes tomorrow (Thu 3 Dec) at 10:00am PT to walk the MAP term sheet and the Pilot acceptance criteria? Agenda attached in-line:

Agenda (30 min):
- 5 min: Quick goals & success metrics for Pilot
- 10 min: Term sheet walkthrough (stepped MAP and pricing)
- 10 min: Ops checklist and key provisioning plan (Lauren)
- 5 min: Next steps & decision milestones
If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a pre-read (pilot test script + QoS PDF).
Best,
Jasmine

From: Emily Park <emily.park@terrainlabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@terrainlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-app expansion planning — proposed time for sync
Confirmed for Thu 3 Dec at 10:00am PT — small change: could we extend to 45 minutes? Tom would like to deep-dive the QoS doc and the proposed burst strategy. If you can make it 45 I’ll have our platform engineer (Andy) drop in for the Pilot acceptance criteria segment.
Also — finance asked for a one-page summary of the stepped MAP and expected TCV impact for the contract amendment. Jasmine — could you include that as a slide in the pre-read?
Uploading their QoS doc now and will review the MAP sheet; Thanks all.
—Emily
Head of Platform Integrations, Terrain Labs
